skill.name: weekly-report-generator
skill.description: Generates weekly and monthly status reports from work logs, including structured summaries, chart guidance, and next-period plans.
skill.summary: Generate weekly or monthly status reports from work logs.
skill.author: Hermes-Sedimentary

security_audit.summary: The high-entropy static finding is a false positive. SKILL.md is readable Markdown with front matter and Chinese marketplace text, and no binary, encrypted, or executable content was found.

static_findings.pattern: [HEURISTIC] High file entropy (6.21 bits) - possible binary/encrypted content

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md is plain readable Markdown with front matter, Chinese text, and a small amount of symbol content. No obfuscated, binary, encrypted, or executable material is present.

content.value_statement: Turning scattered work logs into clear reports takes time. This skill organizes progress, metrics, blockers, and next steps into weekly or monthly summaries.
actual_capabilities: Converts user-provided work logs into structured weekly reports.
Creates monthly report summaries from supplied activity notes.
Organizes completed work, blockers, metrics, and next-period plans.
Suggests chart content when the user provides measurable data.
Supports report drafting in Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
limitations: Requires complete work logs or notes from the user.
Cannot verify facts that are not present in the input.
Chart quality depends on the metrics supplied by the user.
Final reports should be reviewed before sharing.

use_cases.title: Create Personal Status Reports
use_cases.description: Turn daily notes into a clear weekly summary with achievements, blockers, and next steps.

use_cases.title: Prepare Client Updates
use_cases.description: Convert project activity into concise progress reports for recurring client communication.

use_cases.title: Summarize Team Progress
use_cases.description: Organize team updates into a shared report that highlights delivery status and upcoming work.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Weekly Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a weekly report from these work notes. Include completed work, blockers, key results, and next week plans: [paste notes].

prompt_templates.title: Summarize a Monthly Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a monthly report from these logs. Group the output by major projects, measurable outcomes, risks, and next month priorities: [paste logs].

prompt_templates.title: Build a Metrics-Focused Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these task notes and metrics to create a report with summary sections and suggested chart labels: [paste notes and metrics].

prompt_templates.title: Produce an Executive Status Package
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an executive-ready status report from these detailed logs. Include highlights, impact, risks, decisions needed, and next-period commitments: [paste logs].

output_examples.input: A week of notes about shipped features, unresolved bugs, customer calls, and next week priorities.
output_examples.output: A structured weekly report with achievements, issue status, customer feedback themes, blockers, and a clear plan for the next week.

output_examples.input: A monthly activity log with project milestones, task counts, delays, and planned releases.
output_examples.output: A monthly report that groups progress by project, summarizes measurable results, lists risks, and outlines next month actions.

output_examples.input: Team updates with delivery metrics and support volume changes.
output_examples.output: A team status summary with metric highlights, chart suggestions, delivery notes, and follow-up owners.

best_practices: Provide complete work logs with dates, owners, outcomes, and metrics.
Separate completed work, active blockers, and future plans in the input.
Review the generated report for accuracy before sending it.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to invent achievements or missing metrics.
Do not paste private customer data unless it is required and approved.
Do not use the output as a final report without human review.

faq.question: What input does this skill need?
faq.answer: It works best with work logs, task notes, metrics, blockers, and next-period plans.

faq.question: Can it create both weekly and monthly reports?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill description states that it supports weekly and monthly report generation.

faq.question: Does it generate real charts?
faq.answer: It can suggest chart content from supplied metrics. The skill file does not include a separate chart rendering tool.

faq.question: Can teams use it for shared status updates?
faq.answer: Yes. Teams can paste combined updates and ask for a consolidated progress report.

faq.question: Is the output ready to send immediately?
faq.answer: No. Review names, numbers, dates, and commitments before sharing the report.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
